 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 October 29, 2026 
 Link copied 
 BLUE JACKETS (5-5-0) at HURRICANES (10-2-2) 
 7 p.m. ET; CBJHN, HHN, CBJNHL, CARNHL  
 Blue Jackets projected lineup 
 Valeri Nichushkin -- Adam Fantilli -- Kent Johnson
 Matthew Knies -- Charlie Coyle -- Mathieu Olivier
 Sean Monahan -- Cole Sillinger -- Conor Garland
 Danton Heinen -- Luca Del Bel Belluz -- Ryan Lomberg
 Zach Werenski -- Damon Severson
 Jake Christiansen -- Denton Mateychuk
 Dante Fabbro -- Erik Gudbranson
 Jet Greaves
 Cam Talbot 
 Scratched: Carson Soucy, Emil Andrae, Dmitri Voronkov 
 Injured: Ivan Provorov (lower body), Isac Lundestrom (lower body) 
 Hurricanes projected lineup 
 William Carrier -- Sebastian Aho -- Andrei Svechnikov
 Nikolaj Ehlers -- Logan Stankoven -- Jackson Blake
 Jordan Martinook -- Mark Jankowski -- Seth Jarvis 
 Eric Robinson -- Jesperi Kotkaniemi -- Nicolas Deslauriers
 Jacob Slavin -- Jalen Chatfield
 K’Andre Miller -- Sean Walker
 Shayne Gostisbehere -- Juuso Valimaki
 Pyotr Kochetkov
 Brandon Bussi
 Scratched: Mike Reilly 
 Injured: Jordan Staal (calf), Taylor Hall (upper body) 
 Status report 
 Heinen will enter the lineup and replace Voronkov, a forward, after being a healthy scratch the past three games. ... Hall will be out “probably another couple games,” according to Hurricanes coach Rod Brind'Amour, after the forward left morning skate early on Tuesday, prior to a 2-1 win against the Boston Bruins; Hall will miss his seventh straight game.
